versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּשְׁבְּת֡וּ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ֭אֵלֶּה מֵעֲנ֣וֹת אֶת־אִיּ֑וֹב כִּ֤י ה֖וּא צַדִּ֣יק בְּעֵינָֽיו׃פ

controles.web: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
controles.kjv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
controles.livre: Então aqueles três homens cessaram de responder a Jó, porque ele era justo em seus olhos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּ֤חַר אַ֨ף׀ אֱלִיה֣וּא בֶן־בַּרַכְאֵ֣ל הַבּוּזִי֮ מִמִּשְׁפַּ֪חַ֫ת רָ֥ם בְּ֭אִיּוֹב חָרָ֣ה אַפּ֑וֹ עַֽל־צַדְּק֥וֹ נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ מֵאֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.
controles.kjv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
controles.livre: Porém se acendeu a ira de Eliú, filho de Baraquel, buzita, da família de Rão; contra Jó se acendeu sua ira, porque justificava mais a si mesmo que a Deus.

versos.hebraico: וּבִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת רֵעָיו֮ חָרָ֪ה אַ֫פּ֥וֹ עַ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מָצְא֣וּ מַעֲנֶ֑ה וַ֝יַּרְשִׁ֗יעוּ אֶת־אִיּֽוֹב׃

controles.web: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
controles.kjv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
controles.livre: Também sua ira se acendeu contra seus três amigos, porque não achavam o que responder, ainda que tinham condenado a Jó.

versos.hebraico: וֶֽאֱלִיה֗וּ חִכָּ֣ה אֶת־אִ֭יּוֹב בִּדְבָרִ֑ים כִּ֤י זְֽקֵנִים־הֵ֖מָּה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ לְיָמִֽים׃

controles.web: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were elder than he.
controles.kjv: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
controles.livre: E Eliú tinha esperado a Jó naquela discussão, porque tinham mais idade que ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלִיה֗וּא כִּ֘י אֵ֤ין מַעֲנֶ֗ה בְּ֭פִי שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיִּ֥חַר אַפּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.
controles.kjv: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
controles.livre: Porém quando Eliú viu que não havia resposta na boca daqueles três homens, sua ira se acendeu.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַן׀ אֱלִיה֖וּא בֶן־בַּֽרַכְאֵ֥ל הַבּוּזִ֗י וַיֹּ֫אמַ֥ר צָ֘עִ֤יר אֲנִ֣י לְ֭יָמִים וְאַתֶּ֣ם יְשִׁישִׁ֑ים עַל־כֵּ֖ן זָחַ֥לְתִּי וָֽאִירָ֓א׀ מֵחַוֺּ֖ת דֵּעִ֣י אֶתְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered,  “I am young, and you are very old; Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.
controles.kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
controles.livre: Por isso Eliú, filho de Baraquel, buzita, respondeu, dizendo: Eu sou jovem e vós sois idosos; por isso fiquei receoso e tive medo de vos declarar minha opinião.

versos.hebraico: אָ֭מַרְתִּי יָמִ֣ים יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְרֹ֥ב שָׁ֝נִ֗ים יֹדִ֥יעוּ חָכְמָֽה׃

controles.web: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
controles.kjv: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
controles.livre: Eu dizia: Os dias falem, e a multidão de anos ensine sabedoria.

versos.hebraico: אָ֭כֵן רֽוּחַ־הִ֣יא בֶאֱנ֑וֹשׁ וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּבִינֵֽם׃

controles.web: But there is a spirit in man, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
controles.kjv: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
controles.livre: Certamente há espírito no ser humano, e a inspiração do Todo-Poderoso os faz entendedores.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־רַבִּ֥ים יֶחְכָּ֑מוּ וּ֝זְקֵנִ֗ים יָבִ֥ינוּ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.
controles.kjv: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
controles.livre: Não são somente os grandes que são sábios, nem somente os velhos entendem o juízo.

versos.hebraico: לָכֵ֣ן אָ֭מַרְתִּי שִׁמְעָה־לִּ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵּעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’
controles.kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
controles.livre: Por isso eu digo: escutai-me; também eu declararei minha opinião.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן הוֹחַ֨לְתִּי לְֽדִבְרֵיכֶ֗ם אָ֭זִין עַד־תְּב֥וּנֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם עַֽד־תַּחְקְר֥וּן מִלִּֽין׃

controles.web: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.
controles.kjv: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
controles.livre: Eis que eu aguardei vossas palavras, e dei ouvidos a vossas considerações, enquanto vós buscáveis argumentos.

versos.hebraico: וְעָֽדֵיכֶ֗ם אֶתְבּ֫וֹנָ֥ן וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֵ֣ין לְאִיּ֣וֹב מוֹכִ֑יחַ עוֹנֶ֖ה אֲמָרָ֣יו מִכֶּֽם׃

controles.web: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
controles.kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
controles.livre: Eu prestei atenção a vós, porém eis que ninguém há de vós que possa convencer a Jó, nem que responda a suas palavras.

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־תֹּ֣֭אמְרוּ מָצָ֣אנוּ חָכְמָ֑ה אֵ֖ל יִדְּפֶ֣נּוּ לֹא־אִֽישׁ׃

controles.web: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom, God may refute him, not man;’
controles.kjv: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
controles.livre: Portanto não digais: Encontramos a sabedoria; que Deus o derrote, e não o homem.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־עָרַ֣ךְ אֵלַ֣י מִלִּ֑ין וּ֝בְאִמְרֵיכֶ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
controles.kjv: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
controles.livre: Jó não dirigiu suas palavras a mim, nem eu lhe responderei com vossos dizeres.

versos.hebraico: חַ֭תּוּ לֹא־עָ֣נוּ ע֑וֹד הֶעְתִּ֖יקוּ מֵהֶ֣ם מִלִּֽים׃

controles.web: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.
controles.kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
controles.livre: Estão pasmos, não respondem mais; faltam-lhes palavras.

versos.hebraico: וְ֭הוֹחַלְתִּי כִּי־לֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ כִּ֥י עָ֝מְד֗וּ לֹא־עָ֥נוּ עֽוֹד׃

controles.web: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?
controles.kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
controles.livre: Esperei, pois, porém agora não falam; porque já pararam, e não respondem mais.

versos.hebraico: אַעֲנֶ֣ה אַף־אֲנִ֣י חֶלְקִ֑י אֲחַוֶּ֖ה דֵעִ֣י אַף־אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.
controles.kjv: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
controles.livre: Também eu responderei minha parte; também eu declararei minha opinião.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֭י מָלֵ֣תִי מִלִּ֑ים הֱ֝צִיקַ֗תְנִי ר֣וּחַ בִּטְנִֽי׃

controles.web: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.
controles.kjv: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
controles.livre: Porque estou cheio de palavras, e o espírito em meu ventre me obriga.

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּֽה־בִטְנִ֗י כְּיַ֥יִן לֹא־יִפָּתֵ֑חַ כְּאֹב֥וֹת חֲ֝דָשִׁ֗ים יִבָּקֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.
controles.kjv: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
controles.livre: Eis que meu ventre é como o vinho que não tem abertura; e que está a ponto de arrebentar como odres novos.

versos.hebraico: אֲדַבְּרָ֥ה וְיִֽרְוַֽח־לִ֑י אֶפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתַ֣י וְאֶֽעֱנֶֽה׃

controles.web: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
controles.kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
controles.livre: Falarei, para que eu me alivie; abrirei meus lábios, e responderei.

versos.hebraico: אַל־נָ֭א אֶשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי־אִ֑ישׁ וְאֶל־אָ֝דָ֗ם לֹ֣א אֲכַנֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.
controles.kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
controles.livre: Não farei eu acepção de pessoas, nem usarei de títulos lisonjeiros para com o homem.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֲכַנֶּ֑ה כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט יִשָּׂאֵ֥נִי עֹשֵֽׂנִי׃

controles.web: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles; or else my Maker would soon take me away.
controles.kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
controles.livre: Pois não sei lisonjear; caso contrário ,meu Criador logo me removeria.
